title: Progression Feels Better Every Session (v4.4.0)
summary: CogniFocus now gives a clearer focus progression system with smoother XP, live Diamonds rewards, and clearer Google sign-in and backup status across daily sessions.
highlights: Clearer XP progression and level feedback so your focus progress is easier to understand at a glance
Diamonds are now live, including milestone rewards and tier bonuses for Pro and Limitless users
Rewards now feel more connected across streaks, XP, and Diamonds after each session
improvements: Google sign-in and backup status are now easier to understand, including delayed sync updates while you're offline
Settings received a cleaner footer and social layout, plus better mobile polish
Local Dev Tools behavior is more stable when cloud sync is temporarily unavailable
Character and perk unlocks tied to Diamonds are planned for upcoming updates
